newsitem.title: THAILAND: Former Thai finmin against seeking big loans.
newsitem.headline: Former Thai finmin against seeking big loans.

text.p: Thailand's former finance minister Amnuay Viravan disagrees with plans to take out huge foreign loans to spur the economy, saying it could send the wrong signal to the world, local newspapers reported on Monday.
The newspapers quoted Amnuay, who resigned from his post in mid-June, as saying that such borrowing would make Thailand look like another Mexico.

He said major borrowing, which could be up to $10 billion, could send the wrong signal to the international financial community that Thailand's economy was in a critical stage and could only remedied by a large infusion of foreign funding.
